tidbit: Did you know… about 9,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google's Gemini tool helped UK planners cut assessment time by 58 percent in a pilot program. Reported by FourWeekMBA: PlanAssist will roll out to 15 councils by 2027.
Strava now connects your training history to Google Gemini so cyclists can analyze their progress through artificial intelligence. Reported by TodoMountainBike: the integration lets you review your training data with AI.
A tampered Claude Code extension put an SSH backdoor on up to 5,000 Cursor users' computers. Reported by Northeast Times: the malicious extension targeted that user base with a backdoor.
Sam Altman met Samsung executives to discuss memory chip supply and artificial intelligence infrastructure. Reported by ET Enterprise AI: the meeting addressed boosting AI chip supply during global shortages.
ChatGPT had a shared link flaw that exposed private chats before OpenAI fixed it by October 26. Reported by The 420.in: attackers could run code through the vulnerable shared links.
Free every hour.
